ValidationRule.description: Submitted Date and Estimated Award Date are required at the Submitted stage and beyond. Did Not Bid/Cancelled closures, records created before 2026-08-31, and Bypass CapStrat Validation holders are exempt.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: NOT($Permission.Bypass_CapStrat_Validation) && OR(ISNEW(), CreatedDate >= DATETIMEVALUE("2026-08-31 00:00:00")) && OR( ISPICKVAL(CapStrat_Stage__c, "Submitted - Awaiting Customer Decision"), ISPICKVAL(CapStrat_Stage__c, "RFP Shortlisted"), ISPICKVAL(CapStrat_Stage__c, "Shortlisted - Awaiting Customer Decision"), ISPICKVAL(CapStrat_Stage__c, "Awarded"), ISPICKVAL(CapStrat_Stage__c, "RFP Closed") ) && NOT(OR( ISPICKVAL(RFP_Closed__c, "Did Not Bid"), ISPICKVAL(RFP_Closed__c, "Cancelled") )) && ( ISBLANK(Submitted_Date__c) || ISBLANK(Estimated_Award_Date__c) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: To move this Capture Strategy to Submitted (or any later stage), first fill in Submitted Date and Estimated Award Date.
